_help: Act 2, the caravanserai: hiring Saleh al-Rashidi, the veteran guide (hired_saleh), 700. He doesn't haggle; he sends you to Youssef or Farid. How he means to cross, and the men he lost, are on his rapport ladder. Generated by tools/dialogue/make_act2.py.

already.speaker: saleh
already.line: Six days more water than you think. Always.

first.speaker: saleh
first.line: Saleh al-Rashidi. I guide caravans west, and my travellers come home. Seven hundred pounds.

choices.label: Haggle
choices.line: Seven hundred is a lot of money.

haggle.speaker: saleh
haggle.line: My price is my price. Cheaper, ask Youssef. A merchant, ask Farid.

joined.speaker: saleh
joined.line: Then we leave with water for six days more than you think you need.
